home.title: Collect your wishes.
home.description: A book, a little adventure, something you’ve been dreaming of. Keep your wishes in one place and help the people you love find a gift that feels just right.
home.freeNote: The essentials are free. For every little wish.
home.wishNoteDescription: A little more “just what I wished for”.
home.stepsEyebrow: Simple from the very first wish
home.stepsTitle: From “I’d love that” to a lovely surprise
home.stepsDescription: Three little steps to make giving and receiving more thoughtful.
home.collectDescription: Add a wish by hand or with a shop link. Make lists for birthdays, celebrations or just because.
home.shareDescription: Send your list’s link to friends and family. They can open it right in their browser.
home.giveDescription: Guests reserve a wish so other givers know it’s taken. Reservation details stay out of your own view.
home.givingTitle: Received a wishlist link? You’re all set.
home.givingDescription: Open the link, pick a wish and reserve it. You don’t need an account, and leaving your email is optional.
home.questionsEyebrow: A few things you might wonder
home.questionsTitle: Good to know before your first wish
home.faq.accountQuestion: Do my friends need an account?
home.faq.accountAnswer: No. Anyone with an allowed link can view a list and reserve a gift without signing up. A guest’s email is optional.
home.faq.linksQuestion: Can I add a wish without a shop link?
home.faq.linksAnswer: Of course. Add a wish by hand, whether it’s a book, an experience or a helping hand. Shop links, images and prices are optional.
home.faq.privacyAnswer: New lists are available by link. You can make a list private or public. Your full collection stays private unless you choose to publish it in your profile.
home.faq.freeAnswer: The core wishlist features are free: collect wishes, organize lists, share links and reserve gifts. Purchases happen separately, outside Wishix.
home.closingTitle: Every lovely gift starts with a little wish.
home.closingDescription: Give your ideas a home. The next happy surprise can start here.
